name: SMTP
description: A general purpose SMTP connector for sending emails through your own mail server.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The hostname or IP address of the SMTP server.

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port the SMTP server listens on.

fields.name: username
fields.description: The username used to authenticate with the SMTP server.

fields.name: password
fields.description: The password used to authenticate with the SMTP server.

fields.name: authMethod
fields.description: The authentication method to use when connecting to the SMTP server.

fields.name: fromEmail
fields.description: The email address that emails are sent from. Make sure it is properly registered with your server.

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: The name shown as the sender of the emails.
